newsitem.title: USA: BMC Industries sees increased monitor sales.
newsitem.headline: BMC Industries sees increased monitor sales.

text.p: BMC Industries Inc said Thursday it expects significant shipments and sales of its high-resolution computer monitor masks in the fourth quarter.
The company said production of its high-resolution mask line increased in the third quarter but shipments were nominal.
"Due to very demanding nature of high-resolution computer monitor masks, final quality assurance checks permitted only nominal shipments in the third quarter," BMC said in a statement.

"The company has now commenced, subsequent to the third quarter, production volume shipments under firm purchase orders which will result in significant shipments and sales in the fourth quarter," it said.
Earlier, the company reported third quarter earnings of $0.25 versus $0.16 in 1995.
